data.name: Actions.PlaySound.Description
data.value: Plays a soundboard sound in your active Discord voice channel.

data.name: Actions.PlaySound.Sound.Description
data.value: Select the Discord soundboard sound to play.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Step.Description
data.value: Enter your Discord Application Client ID and Client Secret.

data.name: ConfigFlow.ClientId.Description
data.value: The Application ID from your Discord Developer Portal app.

data.name: ConfigFlow.ClientSecret.Description
data.value: The OAuth2 Client Secret from your Discord Developer Portal app.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Instruction
data.value: 1. Go to the Discord Developer Portal and create a New Application. 2. Under OAuth2, make sure https://localhost/ is added to Redirects. 3. Copy your Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below and click Connect.
